$comment: RELEASE PARITY STATE. Enforced by scripts/release-parity-check.ts, which runs in CI and before a release. This file records, for every canonical migration at the release frontier, whether it is believed applied on the hosted database, and which database objects it introduces. The guard fails when application code on this branch references an object whose migration is not applied -- the exact class of failure that stopped employers saving jobs during UAT. It NEVER connects to a database, holds no credentials and applies no migration; it compares this repository against itself. Edit it deliberately: every entry is an owner-level statement about production.

frontier.note: P0 from owner UAT: the new-interview selector and scp_iv_create_case answered different questions, so a pack could be offered and then refused. Introduces the single shared start contract both now call. Not applied hosted.
frontier.verify: SELECT proname FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND proname IN ('scp_iv_case_start_basis','scp_iv_startable_pack_versions','scp_iv_employer_can_start_interviews');

Does not enable AI. Not applied hosted.

No stage, permission, ordinal or claim changes; Swedish remains authoritative. Not applied hosted.

frontier.note: Owner UAT finding B: translation only. Adds English for the 14 prohibited areas, 17 method practices, 39 evidence dimensions and the preparation plan's AI disclosure. Q1-Q8 and the approved probes are deliberately left untranslated and a self-check enforces that. Not applied hosted.

frontier.note: 5E evidence structuring: ten nullable descriptive text columns (five on AI proposals, five on human-confirmed evidence) plus the two governed writers extended to carry them. No numeric completeness, score, total, weighting or threshold; a self-check enforces that every 5E column is nullable text and that nothing aggregates one. Not applied hosted.
frontier.verify: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND column_name ~ '^e[1-5]_';

frontier.note: Translation only, and introduces no object: label_en and anchor_en already existed on scp_interview_rating_anchors and were empty, so nothing read them. Found by walking the interview screen in English -- the behavioural anchors rendered in Swedish, including level 0's sentence that it is not the same thing as low competence. Fills 5 level labels and 33 anchor descriptions, matched on the Swedish text so a reworded anchor stays untranslated and visible. No level, aggregation flag, safety flag or pack version changes; a self-check re-asserts five levels and that level 0 never counts toward aggregation. Not applied hosted.
frontier.verify: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE anchor_en IS NULL) FROM public.scp_interview_rating_anchors;

frontier.note: The TRUST conduct layer for the live interview: six ordered conduct steps (invite, listen, reflect, clarify, substantiate, confirm) and eight named prohibited techniques, both bilingual and pinned to the TRUST method. Deterministic rows only -- the Understand stage still permits zero AI tasks and no stage binding or task permission changes. RLS: active employer members read, nobody but service_role writes; anon has no grant. Not applied hosted.

Governed interviewer guidance for the TRUST stages either side of the live conversation: Target purpose and the five evidence classes, the Ready conduct plan and permitted neutral recall prompts, and the Trace self-review and closure guidance. Deterministic bilingual rows; no new methodology, no new stage, no AI task permission change, and no research claim registered. Not applied hosted.
